verses.he: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵשָׂ֣ו בָּ֔א וְעִמֹּ֕ו אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּ֣חַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִ֗ים עַל־לֵאָה֙ וְעַל־רָחֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַשְּׁפָחֹֽות׃
verses.ar: وَرَفَعَ يَعْقُوبُ عَيْنَيْهِ وَنَظَرَ وَإِذَا عِيسُو مُقْبِلٌ وَمَعَهُ أَرْبَعُ مِئَةِ رَجُلٍ، فَقَسَمَ ٱلْأَوْلَادَ عَلَى لَيْئَةَ وَعَلَى رَاحِيلَ وَعَلَى ٱلْجَارِيَتَيْنِ.
verses.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.kjv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.web: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

verses.he: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־הַשְּׁפָחֹ֛ות וְאֶת־יַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְאֶת־לֵאָ֤ה וִֽילָדֶ֙יהָ֙ אַחֲרֹנִ֔ים וְאֶת־רָחֵ֥ל וְאֶת־יֹוסֵ֖ף אַחֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَوَضَعَ ٱلْجَارِيَتَيْنِ وَأَوْلَادَهُمَا أَوَّلًا، وَلَيْئَةَ وَأَوْلَادَهَا وَرَاءَهُمْ، وَرَاحِيلَ وَيُوسُفَ أَخِيرًا.
verses.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.kjv: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.web: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

verses.he: וְה֖וּא עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֤חוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים עַד־גִּשְׁתֹּ֖ו עַד־אָחִֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا هُوَ فَٱجْتَازَ قُدَّامَهُمْ وَسَجَدَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ حَتَّى ٱقْتَرَبَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ.
verses.en: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.web: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

verses.he: וַיָּ֨רָץ עֵשָׂ֤ו לִקְרָאתֹו֙ וֽ͏ַיְחַבְּקֵ֔הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־צַוָּארָ֖ו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵ֑ׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.ar: فَرَكَضَ عِيسُو لِلِقَائِهِ وَعَانَقَهُ وَوَقَعَ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ وَقَبَّلَهُ، وَبَكَيَا.
verses.en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they wept.
verses.kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.web: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

verses.he: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א אֶת־עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים֙ וְאֶת־הַיְלָדִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הַיְלָדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁר־חָנַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ رَفَعَ عَيْنَيْهِ وَأَبْصَرَ ٱلنِّسَاءَ وَٱلْأَوْلَادَ وَقَالَ: «مَا هَؤُلَاءِ مِنْكَ؟» فَقَالَ: «ٱلْأَوْلَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللهُ بِهِمْ عَلَى عَبْدِكَ».
verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said: 'Who are these with thee?' And he said: 'The children whom God hath graciously given thy servant.'
verses.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who [are] those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.web: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

verses.he: וַתִּגַּ֧שְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָחֹ֛ות הֵ֥נָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן וַתִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽיןָ׃
verses.ar: فَٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلْجَارِيَتَانِ هُمَا وَأَوْلَادُهُمَا وَسَجَدَتَا.
verses.en: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed down.
verses.kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.web: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

verses.he: וַתִּגַּ֧שׁ גַּם־לֵאָ֛ה וִילָדֶ֖יהָ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ וְאַחַ֗ר נִגַּ֥שׁ יֹוסֵ֛ף וְרָחֵ֖ל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱقْتَرَبَتْ لَيْئَةُ أَيْضًا وَأَوْلَادُهَا وَسَجَدُوا. وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ٱقْتَرَبَ يُوسُفُ وَرَاحِيلُ وَسَجَدَا.
verses.en: And Leah also and her children came near, and bowed down; and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed down.
verses.kjv: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.web: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לְךָ֛ כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּגָ֑שְׁתִּי וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לִמְצֹא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «مَاذَا مِنْكَ كُلُّ هَذَا ٱلْجَيْشِ ٱلَّذِي صَادَفْتُهُ؟» فَقَالَ: «لِأَجِدَ نِعْمَةً فِي عَيْنَيْ سَيِّدِي».
verses.en: And he said: 'What meanest thou by all this camp which I met?' And he said: 'To find favour in the sight of my lord.'
verses.kjv: And he said, What [meanest] thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, [These are] to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.web: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר עֵשָׂ֖ו יֶשׁ־לִ֣י רָ֑ב אָחִ֕י יְהִ֥י לְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁר־לָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ عِيسُو: «لِي كَثِيرٌ، يَا أَخِي. لِيَكُنْ لَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَكَ».
verses.en: And Esau said: 'I have enough; my brother, let that which thou hast be thine.'
verses.kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
verses.web: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב אַל־נָא֙ אִם־נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִנְחָתִ֖י מִיָּדִ֑י כִּ֣י עַל־כֵּ֞ן רָאִ֣יתִי פָנֶ֗יךָ כִּרְאֹ֛ת פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַתִּרְצֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ يَعْقُوبُ: «لَا. إِنْ وَجَدْتُ نِعْمَةً فِي عَيْنَيْكَ تَأْخُذْ هَدِيَّتِي مِنْ يَدِي، لِأَنِّي رَأَيْتُ وَجْهَكَ كَمَا يُرَى وَجْهُ ٱللهِ، فَرَضِيتَ عَلَيَّ.
verses.en: And Jacob said: 'Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found favour in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as I have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.kjv: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.web: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

verses.he: קַח־נָ֤א אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻבָ֣את לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־חַנַּ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכִ֣י יֶשׁ־לִי־כֹ֑ל וַיִּפְצַר־בֹּ֖ו וַיִּקָּֽח׃
verses.ar: خُذْ بَرَكَتِي ٱلَّتِي أُتِيَ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ قَدْ أَنْعَمَ عَلَيَّ وَلِي كُلُّ شَيْءٍ». وَأَلَحَّ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ.
verses.en: Take, I pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.' And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.kjv: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took [it].
verses.web: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר נִסְעָ֣ה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לְנֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَالَ: «لِنَرْحَلْ وَنَذْهَبْ، وَأَذْهَبُ أَنَا قُدَّامَكَ».
verses.en: And he said: 'Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.'
verses.kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.web: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֲדֹנִ֤י יֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כִּֽי־הַיְלָדִ֣ים רַכִּ֔ים וְהַצֹּ֥אן וְהַבָּקָ֖ר עָלֹ֣ות עָלָ֑י וּדְפָקוּם֙ יֹ֣ום אֶחָ֔ד וָמֵ֖תוּ כָּל־הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ: «سَيِّدِي عَالِمٌ أَنَّ ٱلْأَوْلَادَ رَخْصَةٌ، وَٱلْغَنَمَ وَٱلْبَقَرَ ٱلَّتِي عِنْدِي مُرْضِعَةٌ، فَإِنِ ٱسْتَكَدُّوهَا يَوْمًا وَاحِدًا مَاتَتْ كُلُّ ٱلْغَنَمِ.
verses.en: And he said unto him: 'My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds giving suck are a care to me; and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children [are] tender, and the flocks and herds with young [are] with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.web: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

verses.he: יַעֲבָר־נָ֥א אֲדֹנִ֖י לִפְנֵ֣י עַבְדֹּ֑ו וַאֲנִ֞י אֶֽתְנָהֲלָ֣ה לְאִטִּ֗י לְרֶ֨גֶל הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנַי֙ וּלְרֶ֣גֶל הַיְלָדִ֔ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־אָבֹ֥א אֶל־אֲדֹנִ֖י שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.ar: لِيَجْتَزْ سَيِّدِي قُدَّامَ عَبْدِهِ، وَأَنَا أَسْتَاقُ عَلَى مَهَلِي فِي إِثْرِ ٱلْأَمْلَاكِ ٱلَّتِي قُدَّامِي، وَفِي إِثْرِ ٱلْأَوْلَادِ، حَتَّى أَجِيءَ إِلَى سَيِّدِي إِلَى سَعِيرَ».
verses.en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant; and I will journey on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.'
verses.kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.web: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַצִּֽיגָה־נָּ֣א עִמְּךָ֔ מִן־הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אֶמְצָא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.ar: فَقَالَ عِيسُو: «أَتْرُكُ عِنْدَكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعِي». فَقَالَ: «لِمَاذَا؟ دَعْنِي أَجِدْ نِعْمَةً فِي عَيْنَيْ سَيِّدِي».
verses.en: And Esau said: 'Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me.' And he said: 'What needeth it? let me find favour in the sight of my lord.'
verses.kjv: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee [some] of the folk that [are] with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.web: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

verses.he: וַיָּשָׁב֩ בַּיֹּ֨ום הַה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֛ו לְדַרְכֹּ֖ו שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.ar: فَرَجَعَ عِيسُو ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِي طَرِيقِهِ إِلَى سَعِيرَ.
verses.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.kjv: ¶ So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.web: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

verses.he: וְיַעֲקֹב֙ נָסַ֣ע סֻכֹּ֔תָה וַיִּ֥בֶן לֹ֖ו בָּ֑יִת וּלְמִקְנֵ֙הוּ֙ עָשָׂ֣ה סֻכֹּ֔ת עַל־כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־הַמָּקֹ֖ום סֻכֹּֽות׃ ס
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا يَعْقُوبُ فَٱرْتَحَلَ إِلَى سُكُّوتَ، وَبَنَى لِنَفْسِهِ بَيْتًا، وَصَنَعَ لِمَوَاشِيهِ مِظَالًا. لِذَلِكَ دَعَا ٱسْمَ ٱلْمَكَانِ «سُكُّوتَ».
verses.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.kjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.web: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹא֩ יַעֲקֹ֨ב שָׁלֵ֜ם עִ֣יר שְׁכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּבֹאֹ֖ו מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיִּ֖חַן אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَتَى يَعْقُوبُ سَالِمًا إِلَى مَدِينَةِ شَكِيمَ ٱلَّتِي فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ، حِينَ جَاءَ مِنْ فَدَّانِ أَرَامَ. وَنَزَلَ أَمَامَ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ.
verses.en: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which [is] in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.web: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

verses.he: וַיִּ֜קֶן אֶת־חֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה־שָׁם֙ אָהֳלֹ֔ו מִיַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־חֲמֹ֖ור אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם בְּמֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَٱبْتَاعَ قِطْعَةَ ٱلْحَقْلِ ٱلَّتِي نَصَبَ فِيهَا خَيْمَتَهُ مِنْ يَدِ بَنِي حَمُورَ أَبِي شَكِيمَ بِمِئَةِ قَسِيطَةٍ.
verses.en: And he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for a hundred pieces of money.
verses.kjv: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.
verses.web: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

verses.he: וַיַּצֶּב־שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּ֨קְרָא־לֹ֔ו אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ ס
verses.ar: وَأَقَامَ هُنَاكَ مَذْبَحًا وَدَعَاهُ «إِيلَ إِلَهَ إِسْرَائِيلَ».
verses.en: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.
verses.kjv: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.
verses.web: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
